title: Get vaccinated through the National Immunisation Program
summary: Find out about your eligibility for free vaccines and how to get vaccinated through the National Immunisation Program.
intro:
You may be eligible for free vaccines through the National Immunisation Program (NIP). The NIP provides immunisation to help reduce diseases that can be prevented by vaccination.

Eligible participants include:

You’ll need to contact your preferred vaccination provider to ask about the specific vaccines they can administer.

For more details on the vaccines available and your eligibility, visit the National Immunisation Program website.

You can find out about what vaccinations you've already had, print a history, or get digital copies of records at the Australian Immunisation Register.

If you have questions or feedback about this program contact The Australian Government Department of Health, Disability and Ageing.
